title: Determine the initial and subsequent measurement of indefinite life intangible assets and goodwill

items.concept: Initial recognition JE (goodwill residual + indefinite brand/IPR&D); multi-year subsequent carrying-amount schedule (zero amortization emphasis); period-end finite amort only; disposal of indefinite-life brand
Number-variant twin: initial recognition of goodwill and indefinite-life intangibles; multi-year zero-amortization subsequent schedule; disposal of trade name with gain
Multi-period crypto fair-value subsequent measurement schedule and period-end adjusting JEs; standalone indefinite trademark at cost with no amortization; disposal of crypto
Classification of subsequent measurement — amortize finite patent only; not trademark, incomplete IPR&D, or goodwill (public company)
